candidates.full: В «Телеграме» обнаружили уязвимость, позволяющую получить контроль над клиентом пользователя. Разработчики мессенджера «навайбкодили» эту дыру в безопасности, считают эксперты Во вторник 10 ноября основатель Telegram Павел Дуров анонсировал обновление Bot API 10.4 с поддержкой HTML-виджетов и платежей через TON-кошелёк в мессенджере. Новая функция позволяет превратить любое сообщение в чатах в компактное приложение со встроенной функцией оплаты, написал Дуров. 🔵 Как устроено. Виджеты в чатах — это HTML-документы со встроенными стилями и JavaScript. Команды выполняются в виртуальной среде (песочнице) без прямого доступа к сети на QuickJS — движке для языка JavaScript. 🔵 На Android. Уже на следующий день команда специалистов по информационной безопасности V12 выложила видео , на котором производит удаленное выполнение кода (remote code execution; RCE) через виджет на клиенте «Телеграма» для Android. В ролике «злоумышленник» запускает бот, затем на устройстве через RCE запускается калькулятор. «Любое сообщение в "Телеграме" теперь может стать RCE», — написали специалисты, перефразировав Павла Дурова. В Telegram заявили , что проблема на Android была решена еще 10 ноября, а 11 ноября исправление применено ко всем пользователям. ИБ-компания Nebula Security заявила, что разработчики Telegram должным образом не изолировали песочницу QuickJS. Запуск JavaScript в нативном сообщении без изоляции — огромная ошибка. Так бывает, когда у вас нет партнера по безопасности, который бы проверил ваш проект, — говорится в сообщении компании. В Nebula Security считают, что разработчикам Telegram теперь не достаточно устранить одну уязвимость, так как дизайн нового функционала сделан без учета ИБ-практик. В будущем будут возникать всё новые уязвимости, говорят там. Ребята, пожалуйста, хватит вайбкодить собственную структуру безопасности, притормозите, — написал по этому поводу сооснователь Nebula Security Сяочэнь Цзоу. С оценкой Nebula согласен OffSec-специалист Джоэл Эрикссон. По его словам, любого эксплойта QuickJS будет достаточно, чтобы получить полный контроль над клиентом «Телеграма» со всеми правами, которые есть у клиента в конкретной операционной системе, и уязвимости будут появляться вновь. 🔵 На iOS . Эрикссон пишет, что ему удалось воспроизвести полную цепочку эксплойтов для удаленного выполнения кода, имея все последние обновления для клиента под iOS с GitHub. Специалист приходит к выводу, что по состоянию на вечер 12 ноября разработчики Telegram не устранили уязвимость, которую использовали эксперты V12 в проверке клиента Android. Она остается и в версиях для iOS, и в десктопной версии мессенджера. В публично доступных версиях также не устранены и другие уязвимости, в том числе на Android. При этом Эрикссон не исключает, что проблема может быть решена в пока еще не доступной для анализа версии iOS 13.2.1. 🔵 На Windows. Уже 13 ноября команда V12 опубликовала видео , но котором выполняет RCE с открытием калькулятора уже на якобы исправленной десктопной версии для Windows (вероятно, речь о версии 7.4.3). Даже если отдельные уязвимости и исправляются, возможность использования (вне песочницы!) QuickJS в сообщениях значительно расширяет поверхность атаки, — заключили там. Пользователь GitHub с ником Bikini также сообщает , что ему удалось успешно выполнить RCE на десктопной версии мессенджера 7.4.2 как минимум одним способом. 🔵 Кому грозит. Риска подвергнуться такой атаке при обычном чтении каналов в «Телеграме» нет. Уязвимость присутствует в личных чатах с ботами. Эксперты советуют не активировать интерактивные карточки ботов в чатах и сохраняют прежние рекомендации: не использовать «Телеграм» для чувствительной переписки. Выводы специалистов в беседе с «Важными историями» подтверждает ИБ-архитектор ведущих российских и европейских компаний, попросивший об анонимности. Вероятность, что уязвимости найдут еще и там же — сильно выше нулевой. С LLM (Large Language Model) последний месяц в интернете с уязвимостями вообще кровавая баня. В целом архитектурно это хуевое решение, они наломают с QuickJS дров, — говорит он. ИБ-специалист уверен, что разработчики Telegram при создании этого функционала занимались вайбкодингом и толком не тестировали результат. Недавние изменения для widget-sandbox , по его мнению, по манере написания выглядят как работа Claude. Эксперт предупреждает, что риск атаки существует для любого пользователя, которому приходит сообщение с виджетом. Не факт, что получится украсть прям всё, но как минимум уронить клиент или залезть в память на устройстве, — говорит он. Неприемлемая безответственность — создавать такой функционал с настолько слабой архитектурой безопасности, учитывая, что у «Телеграма» около миллиарда активных пользователей, и его (наивно) используют люди с внушительными рисками стать целью киберпреступников и/или государственных акторов, — заключает Джоэл Эрикссон. candidates.title: Українська Vigilant Works залучила американські інвестиції: компанія розвиває перехоплювачі Algiz-2, двигуни до яких виготовлятимуть у Литві
candidates.summary: Українська оборонна компанія Vigilant Works залучила інвестиції американського венчурного фонду Backswing Ventures. Vigilant Works розробляє автономні системи протидії безпілотникам, високошвидкісні дрони-перехоплювачі та радіолокаційні технології. Раніше стартап отримав фінансування від українськог
candidates.full: Українська оборонна компанія Vigilant Works залучила інвестиції американського венчурного фонду Backswing Ventures. Vigilant Works розробляє автономні системи протидії безпілотникам, високошвидкісні дрони-перехоплювачі та радіолокаційні технології. Раніше стартап отримав фінансування від українського Angel One Fund. Паралельно компанія розвиває співпрацю з литовським виробником Sky Motors Lab, з яким планує створювати спеціалізовані електродвигуни для високошвидкісних дронів-перехоплювачів. Сума інвестиції та інші фінансові умови не розголошуються. Залучений капітал українська компанія планує спрямувати на розвиток технологій автономного наведення, радарних систем нового покоління та підготовку до масштабування виробництва і виходу на ринки країн НАТО. Vigilant Works вже уклала перші комерційні угоди за межами України. Але назви замовників, країни постачання, обсяги контрактів і фінансові умови компанія поки не розкриває. Backswing Ventures — американський венчурний фонд, заснований у 2020 році, який спеціалізується на інвестиціях в оборонні та технологічні компанії подвійного призначення (dual-use). Серед тих, у кого інвестував фонд, компанії, що працюють над автономними системами, штучним інтелектом, ракетними технологіями, кібербезпекою та засобами виявлення загроз. У липні 2026 року український венчурний фонд Angel One оголосив про інвестицію в компанію. Для фонду це була четверта угода в оборонному секторі за 2026 рік. Точну суму угоди сторони тоді не розкрили. Однак типовий розмір інвестиції Angel One становить від $50 тисяч до $200 тисяч. Angel One повідомляв про додаткову грантову підтримку розробки Vigilant Works — Algiz-2. Vigilant Works створює інтегровану екосистему протидії безпілотним літальним апаратам, яка має об'єднати три основні компоненти: перехоплювачі, технології автономного управління та радіолокаційні засоби виявлення. Першою розробкою компанії стала платформа Algiz-1, яка вже пройшла бойові випробування. Наразі команда працює над Algiz-2 — високошвидкісним перехоплювачем, здатним розвивати швидкість понад 600 км/год. Платформа вже перейшов до активної фази бойових випробувань. Співзасновник Vigilant Works Даніель Корогодський вважає, що майбутнє протидії безпілотникам залежить від інтеграції всього циклу перехоплення. На його думку, радар, автономне управління та високошвидкісна платформа мають розроблятися як єдина система, а не як окремі компоненти. Нагадаємо, Vigilant Works стала співпраця з литовською компанією Sky Motors Lab. Vigilant Works створює автономні дрони-перехоплювачі, які можуть літати зі швидкістю понад 600 км/год. Для таких швидкісних польотів потрібні двигуни, здатні витримувати високі температури та значні навантаження. Саме їх збирається розробляти литовська Sky Motors Lab. Компанія проєктуватиме, створюватиме й тестуватиме спеціальні безколекторні електродвигуни, пристосовані до роботи на таких швидкостях. candidates.title: Nvidia Crisis Prompts Scrutiny of Lutnick’s Role in Chip Policy - Bloomberg.com
candidates.summary: Nvidia Crisis Prompts Scrutiny of Lutnick’s Role in Chip Policy Fallout from Jensen Huang's ouster as Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer is reaching deep into Washington, where Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has drawn scrutiny over whether his department did enough to keep the company's prized
candidates.full: Nvidia Crisis Prompts Scrutiny of Lutnick’s Role in Chip Policy Fallout from Jensen Huang's ouster as Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer is reaching deep into Washington, where Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has drawn scrutiny over whether his department did enough to keep the company's prized artificial intelligence chips out of China's hands. Congress is demanding answers from Lutnick and other Trump administration officials about decisions that may have made it easier for China to obtain Nvidia's advanced semiconductors as well as the degree to which Silicon Valley leaders like Jensen Huang may have influenced policy. The Senate Banking committee is planning inquiries into Lutnick and Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler's decision-making, with lawmakers threatening probes into the Bureau of Industry and Security, which regulates exports of advanced AI chips. Fallout from Jensen Huang’s ouster as Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer is reaching deep into Washington, where Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has drawn scrutiny over whether his department did enough to keep the company’s prized artificial intelligence chips out of China’s hands. As the ultimate overseer of US export control programs, Lutnick would be accountable for any policy or enforcement gaps that allowed Nvidia’s AI processors to reach unauthorized Chinese buyers. For now, the Commerce chief has the blessing of President Donald Trump, who gave Lutnick a vote of confidence hours after Nvidia announced Huang’s resignation on Thursday. Huang’s abrupt departure was prompted by revelations that he’d had an affair with a woman suspected by US officials of spying for China and whose Singapore-based company Megaspeed had been under investigation by Commerce for possible export control violations. Megaspeed has denied any wrongdoing, while the former Nvidia chief’s romantic partner, Alice Huang, is now in China. In the aftermath, Congress is demanding answers from Lutnick and other Trump administration officials about decisions that may have made it easier for China to obtain Nvidia’s advanced semiconductors as well as the degree to which Silicon Valley leaders like Jensen Huang may have influenced policy. Pressure on the administration and the tech sector is escalating a week after an election where voters expressed intense frustrations over the impact of the AI boom. “I would like for Secretary Lutnick ASAP to come testify before the Senate Banking Committee because we have a lot of bipartisan questions and concerns about what’s happened over the last year,” Senator Jim Banks, an Indiana Republican, said in an interview on Fox News. Late Thursday night, a Commerce Department spokesperson, Kristen Eichamer, said in a statement that “Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions.” Axios reported on Wednesday that Trump had authorized a new crackdown on companies suspected of diverting advanced AI chips to China, but that Lutnick delayed acting on the directive. Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi, an Illinois Democrat, called the report “deeply, deeply disturbing.” On at least three separate occasions earlier this year — in May, August and earlier this month — Trump approved taking action against suspected diversions of Nvidia chips to China, Axios reported. This week’s events are “a freaking disaster at this point, and it deserves tremendous scrutiny not only by obviously Nvidia’s board, but by the intelligence community and the US government as well,” Krishnamoorthi said in an interview on Bloomberg Television Wednesday. Further complicating the dynamic are allegations by Democratic lawmakers that Lutnick’s sons, who hold leadership positions at Cantor Fitzgerald, are profiting off of policy decisions that he makes. Lutnick, who previously was CEO of Cantor, divested his stake as legally required before becoming secretary, and elevated his sons to top jobs at the firm. People with ties to the White House, who asked not to be identified describing private conversations, said Lutnick has been marginalized within the administration for a while. At the same time, his exit has been predicted before but it has not happened. A White House official, who requested anonymity, said in an emailed statement that Trump maintains complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to carry out the position as the most transformative commerce secretary in modern history. The Commerce Department didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. Cantor Fitzgerald declined to comment. One element of the Nvidia imbroglio is a little-known but powerful Commerce Department agency that’s known as the Bureau of Industry and Security and falls under Lutnick’s jurisdiction. BIS regulates exports of a wide range of products — including advanced AI chips — and it’s set to face renewed scrutiny as lawmakers threaten probes into the bureau’s leader, Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler. Read More: Trump’s AI Chip Export Push Stymied by Bureaucratic Bottleneck The Senate Banking committee is already planning inquiries into Lutnick and Kessler’s decision-making. The two men “must explain why they have not closed export control loopholes and act today to ensure our advanced technology is not fueling China’s military,” Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the committee, said in a statement. In late summer 2025, Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter called Kessler to ask whether BIS was involved in the Singapore government’s recent detention of Alice Huang, Bloomberg News reported this week. BIS was not involved in that action, Bloomberg reported earlier, citing people familiar with the matter. An Nvidia spokesperson has said that Teter was unaware of the affair at the time he called Kessler about Alice Huang’s detention in Singapore. But in the weeks following the call, BIS staff were muzzled in their ability to investigate the company, including a mandate that they route all request of Nvidia through Kessler, Bloomberg reported. BIS spokespeople earlier denied any wrongdoing. “It’s really important to understand what the Commerce Department knew about Megaspeed,” said Ben Buchanan, former White House special adviser for AI during the Biden administration, in a Bloomberg Television interview. “This is an incident where the enforcement is not good. The decision making has not been good.” — With assistance from Courtney Subramanian, John Harney, and Josh Wingrove (Updates with Lutnick agreeing to testify, in seventh paragraph.)

candidates.title: Масштабний збій стався у сервісах Microsoft: ситуація в Україні
candidates.summary: Масштабний збій стався у сервісах Microsoft: ситуація в Україні Київ • УНН Глобальний збій Microsoft 365 заблокував доступ до Outlook і частково Teams. Microsoft відновлює сервери, проблеми зафіксували й в Україні. Масштабний збій стався у роботі Microsoft 365 і відрізав людей від електронної пошти.
candidates.full: Масштабний збій стався у сервісах Microsoft: ситуація в Україні Київ • УНН Глобальний збій Microsoft 365 заблокував доступ до Outlook і частково Teams. Microsoft відновлює сервери, проблеми зафіксували й в Україні. Масштабний збій стався у роботі Microsoft 365 і відрізав людей від електронної пошти. Про це УНН пише з посиланням на The Verge. Деталі З приблизно 20:00 за Києвом у четвер, 12 листопада, з усього світу надходять повідомлення про те, що люди не можуть отримати доступ до своєї електронної пошти Outlook, ні через веб, ні через програми. Microsoft швидко визнала проблему у своєму акаунті Microsoft 365 Status, заявивши: "Ми визначили, що частина інфраструктури відчуває підвищене навантаження в кількох регіонах, що, ймовірно, сприяє помилкам підключення". Також були деякі повідомлення про проблеми з Teams, але не в такій же мірі, тоді як в офіційних оновленнях Microsoft зазначено, що клієнти можуть зіткнутися з проблемами в пакеті бізнес-сервісів 365. Директор з комунікацій Microsoft Бен Гоуп заявив: "Ми знаємо та розслідуємо повідомлення про проблеми користувачів із сервісами Microsoft 365, головним чином з Exchange Online. Ми цінуємо терпіння наших клієнтів, поки ми працюємо над тим, щоб якомога швидше відновити сервіси". Кілька годин потому Microsoft опублікувала кілька варіантів оновлень щодо проблем та спроб їх виправити, заявивши, що у неї виникли проблеми з перезавантаженням серверів та можливістю моніторингу їхнього стану. Станом на 1:00 13 листопада за Києвом Microsoft опублікувала повідомлення про те, що їй вдалося відновити роботу деяких уражених серверів. "Ми почали повертати частину уражених серверів до роботи, і поки що вони залишаються стабільними. Ми також перенаправили трафік і з'єднання на альтернативні шляхи, де це можливо, і спостерігаємо обмежене відновлення в деяких регіонах. Ми спростили процес відновлення, щоб пришвидшити повернення до роботи решти уражених серверів. Для подальшої підтримки відновлення ми впроваджуємо захисні заходи управління трафіком у певному місці, щоб зменшити навантаження на уражену інфраструктуру, і ми розширимо ці заходи на додаткові місця, якщо побачимо позитивні результати", - ідеться у заяві. Станом на 8:45 за Києвом на сайті Microsoft Service Health Status повідомлялося про "погіршення роботи сервісів Microsoft 365 (Business або Enterprise) та споживчих продуктів Microsoft". "Користувачі можуть не мати змоги підключитися до кількох служб Microsoft 365", - ішлося у повідомленні щодо Microsoft 365 (Business or Enterprise). Як зазначало BBC, десятки тисяч користувачів у світі выдчули на собі глобальний збій сервісів компанії Microsoft, у тому числі емейл-клієнта Outlook, сервісу відеоконференцій Teams та ШІ-чату Copilot. Промпти Copilot, як зазначається, можуть оброблятися повільно або взагалі не оброблятися у встановлений час. Збій також торкнувся деяких сторонніх сервісів, що не належать Microsoft. Компанії OpenAI та Anthropic повідомили про збої в їхніх продуктах (великих мовних моделях) у тій частині, де вони сполучаються з продуктами Microsoft. Ситуація в Україні За даними моніторингового сервісу Downdetector, збій Microsoft 365 зачепив й українських користувачів. Станом на 8:30 були звіти про відчування проблем з його роботою. Найбільше повідомлень про проблеми було щодо входу (37%), додатка (30%), збереження / синхронізації (20%). candidates.full: «Крім двох уже відомих». У ексгенерального директора Nvidia Хуанга був ще один роман із співробітницею компанії — Reuters У агентстві Reuters не назвали ім'я та прізвище ще однієї співробітниці Reuters, яка мала роман з Дженсеном Хуангом (Фото: REUTERS/Nathan Howard) Колишній генеральний директор Nvidia Дженсен Хуанг мав стосунки з іще однією співробітницею компанії. Про це 12 листопада повідомляє агентство Reuters з посиланням на два поінформовані джерела. «Ця інформація з’явилася після того, як стало відомо про два інших позашлюбних зв’язки Хуанга, які й призвели до його відставки в четвер. Йдеться про Еліс Хуанг, яку американські спецслужби підозрюють у шпигунстві на користь Китаю, та віцепрезидентку Nvidia з питань охорони здоров’я Кімберлі Пауелл», — пише видання. У Reuters не назвали ім'я та прізвище ще однієї співробітниці, яка мала роман з Хуангом. «Спроби зв’язатися з цією жінкою не увінчалися успіхом», — пише агентство. У компанії Nvidia відмовилися коментувати Reuters цю інформацію. Пауелл, Дженсен Хуанг та представники ради директорів Nvidia не відповіли на запити агентства щодо коментарів. З Еліс Хуанг зв’язатися для отримання коментарів не вдалося, підсумували в Reuters. 8 листопада рада директорів компанії Nvidia оголосила про початок незалежного розслідування — після появи інформації про те, що Хуанг міг стати «мішенню операції іноземної розвідки». Сам Хуанг у службовій записці співробітникам Nvidia визнав, що зраджував дружині, і перепросив за це. За даними ЗМІ, у нього був роман із колишньою головою сінгапурської компанії Megaspeed Еліс Хуанг. Видання The New York Times повідомляло, що представники американської розвідки дійшли висновку, що Еліс Хуанг могла передавати інформацію Пекіну, а романтичні стосунки, ймовірно, використовувалися для отримання конфіденційних даних про технології штучного інтелекту та обходу експортних обмежень США. Сам Китай ці звинувачення відкинув. Крім того, видання NYT повідомляло, що у Дженсена Хуанга також був роман із віцепрезидентом Nvidia з питань охорони здоров’я Кімберлі Пауелл. 12 листопада агентство Bloomberg повідомило, що генеральний директор компанії Nvidia Дженсен Хуанг пішов у відставку після оприлюднення інформації про два його позашлюбні стосунки. Обов’язки генерального директора тимчасово виконуватиме фінансовий директор Колетт Кресс.

candidates.full: Blackstone’s QTS Is Cutting AI Debt Sale by More Than Half QTS, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is raising about $300 million after initially targeting roughly $800 million in a planned private debt sale. Some investors balked at the price the borrower was offering, while some faced constraints because the company has tapped the private placement market several times. Blackstone opted to proceed with a smaller financing at its desired pricing, instead of hiking spreads and raising the full $800 million. QTS, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is slashing the size of a planned private debt sale by about 60% after struggling to attract enough demand from investors — and refusing to pay much higher yields. The company is raising about $300 million after initially targeting roughly $800 million, according to people with knowledge of the transaction. Some investors balked at the price the borrower was offering, while some faced constraints because the company has tapped the private placement market several times, the people said, asking not to be identified discussing a private matter. AI companies are facing challenges as they tap every corner of capital markets from investment-grade bonds to project financing to finance investments that could run into the trillions of dollars in the coming years. QTS has raised billions of dollars in the private-placement market through at least two debt sales over the past 18 months. That includes a $1.65 billion high-grade bond sale last year and another $800 million financing. Blackstone was reluctant to offer significantly higher yields on its latest borrowing because it finances frequently across multiple markets and issuers, according to the people. Wider pricing on the QTS transaction could establish a more expensive reference point for investors evaluating other Blackstone-related debt, the people said. The $300 million financing included a $100 million seven-year US private placement that was priced on Friday to yield 2.45 percentage points more than benchmarks. It also includes a $200 million five-year bank loan portion that is expected to be priced in the coming weeks, one of the people said, asking not to be identified discussing confidential information. The data center developer had planned to use the $800 million private placement to refinance existing five-year bank debt. With the smaller offering, that bank financing can remain in place, one of the people said. A representative at Blackstone declined to comment. The private placement market is significantly smaller than the public bond market and is dominated by investors such as life insurers and asset managers that typically hold the debt for the long term, potentially limiting how much exposure they are willing to build to a single borrower over a relatively short period. Issuance in the investment-grade true private placement market last year was just above $200 billion, according to the Private Placement Monitor. QTS has also tapped other credit markets this year. It sold project finance green bonds in April and August, borrowing $4.6 billion for the first deal and $3.9 billion for the second. Blackstone acquired QTS in 2021 for about $10 billion including debt. The data-center operator has since tapped multiple pools of capital to finance its expansion amid a surge in spending on infrastructure needed to support artificial intelligence.

candidates.title: Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
candidates.summary: Top Chinese Frontier AI Models Carry the Fingerprint of Export-Controlled NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs Executive Summary Our forensic analysis of publicly released AI models finds evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group have gained access to NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPUs, despite restrictions
candidates.full: Top Chinese Frontier AI Models Carry the Fingerprint of Export-Controlled NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs Executive Summary Our forensic analysis of publicly released AI models finds evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group have gained access to NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPUs, despite restrictions on exporting these chips to China, and are using that hardware to create their AI models. Six models released by these companies since April 2026 contain numerical patterns matching Blackwell hardware, whereas earlier models from the same companies match NVIDIA’s older Hopper generation. The findings suggest that several leading Chinese AI developers have begun using Blackwell to train their newest models. U.S. officials and press reports had already alleged that DeepSeek and Moonshot AI were using Blackwell chips, without publishing technical evidence. The evidence comes entirely from the models’ own published weights, rather than from leaks or insider accounts. We recover traces of the models’ initial values, and then search for the hardware configurations and initial configurations that reproduce them; for DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi K3, we also confirmed the match on physical Blackwell chips. The fingerprint identifies how the weights were created and supports, without proving, the inference that Blackwell also performed the training. Specially configured AMD hardware, which is also restricted from export to China, is the only alternative we have identified; we have excluded it for DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and consider it very unlikely for the other five models. Notably, our findings provide technical evidence of access to advanced computing hardware, but do not establish where the chips were located, how access was obtained, or whether export controls were violated. Table 1. Hardware fingerprints in successive models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group Link ↗ | Lab | Model | Released | Chip the model was started on | |---|---|---|---| | DeepSeek | DeepSeek-V3 | Dec 2024 | NVIDIA Hopper (lab disclosed H800) | | | DeepSeek-V4-Flash | Apr 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell B200/B300 | | | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | Apr 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell GB200/GB300 | | Moonshot AI | Kimi K2 | Jul 2025 | NVIDIA Hopper (lab disclosed H800) | | | Kimi K2.5 | Jan 2026 | NVIDIA Hopper (lab disclosed H800) | | | Kimi K3 | Jul 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell GB200/GB300 | | | Kimi K3.1-Pro | Nov 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell GB200/GB300 | | MiniMax | MiniMax-M2.7 | Apr 2026 | NVIDIA Hopper | | | MiniMax-M3 | Jun 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell B200/B300 | | Ant Group | Ling-3.0-flash | Aug 2026 | NVIDIA Hopper | | | Ling-3.1-flash | Oct 2026 | • NVIDIA Blackwell GB200/GB300 | • Requires a U.S. license for export to China; none have been reported. A Hopper fingerprint cannot distinguish an H800 from an H100 SXM or H200; the H800 identifications above are lab disclosures, not findings of this method. Full list of models in Appendix 2 ↓ Main Findings - Six models from four Chinese labs read as Blackwell-trained. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M3 match NVIDIA’s Blackwell-class B200 or B300 chips, which have 148 processor cores (called streaming multiprocessors, or SMs). DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1-Pro and Ling-3.1-flash match the GB200 or GB300 chips, also Blackwell-class, which have 152 processor cores. Kimi K3.1-Pro starts from the same seed as K3, and may be a checkpoint of K3 with further post-training. - Chinese labs started training on Blackwell relatively recently. DeepSeek’s models read as Hopper-trained through DeepSeek-V3 (released in December 2024), and as Blackwell from DeepSeek V4 (released in April 2026). Moonshot’s models read as Hopper through Kimi K2.5 (January 2026) and as Blackwell from K3 (July 2026). One Moonshot model sits in between: Kimi K2.7-Code, posted six weeks before K3, is built on the Hopper-era weights but contains a small part that matches the B200 or B300. MiniMax’s models read as Hopper through M2.7 (April 2026) and as Blackwell from M3 (June 2026). Ant Group’s Ling-3.0-flash (August 2026) reads as Hopper, while its Ling-3.1-flash (October 2026) reads as Blackwell. The Hopper readings do not identify a specific chip: H800s, H100 SXMs and H200s share the same fingerprint. - Not every Chinese AI lab has switched to Blackwell. The newest models we could read from Alibaba (Qwen), Zhipu (GLM), Tencent, Xiaomi and StepFun all read as Hopper-trained. Meituan says its LongCat-2.0 was trained entirely on “AI ASIC superpods,” and we found no NVIDIA fingerprint in the model weights it’s released. - The method gets known answers right. For 24 specific models, the developer has publicly said what hardware was used. In every case, our method agrees with the public announcement. NVIDIA’s own Nemotron-3 Ultra, whose technical report names the GB200 for one phase of its training, reads as 152 SMs, the same as Kimi K3. - The matches are far stronger than chance would explain. Even unrelated numbers can appear to match when enough combinations are tried. Across the roughly 6 trillion seed-and-layout combinations in our search, the strongest chance match would be expected to reach about 8 sigma—a measure of how far a result stands above ordinary random variation. The strongest evidence for each of the six models ranges from 49 to 1,385 sigma. Even the weakest individual test we report reaches 20 sigma. - The training runs were data-center scale. From each model’s size and the amount of data it was trained on, we estimate that each run needed roughly 500 to 3,000 Blackwell GPUs for two to three months (Table 2), assuming each model was trained on the hardware that initialized it. The same arithmetic applied to DeepSeek-V3 gives 2,000 to 2,500 chips; DeepSeek disclosed 2,048. At roughly $70,000 per GPU—the cost implied by a Wall Street Journal report that about 36,000 Blackwell chips being installed in Malaysia for ByteDance’s use would cost more than $2.5 billion—the largest of these clusters would cost $150 million to $200 million, and the five together more than half a billion dollars. These figures cover only the final training runs; the labs’ total spending on export-controlled GPUs is likely in the billions of dollars. Table 2. Rough scale of each training run Link ↗ | Model | Blackwell GPUs, best estimate | Range | |---|---|---| | DeepSeek-V4-Flash | 1,000–1,500 | 250–4,500 | | DeepSeek-V4-Pro | 2,000–2,500 | 750–6,000 | | Kimi K3 | 2,000–3,000 | 1,000–8,000 | | MiniMax-M3 | 500–600 | 200–2,000 | | Ling-3.1-flash | 1,100–1,650 | 400–6,500 | Training compute (about 6 × active parameters × training tokens) divided by chip throughput at 35% utilization, over a run of two to three months (six to eight weeks for DeepSeek-V4-Flash). DeepSeek disclosed its token counts; for the other models, we estimated them from the weights. Our investigation A model’s weights, also called parameters, are the billions of adjustable numbers that determine how it processes information and produces answers. Training repeatedly adjusts these numbers; but before training can begin, they need initial values. In the software examined here, those values come from a pseudorandom number generation (PRNG) algorithm called Philox: Philox produces seemingly random numbers in a deterministic way. The starting input for Philox is a number called the “seed.” Given the same seed and settings, Philox produces the same numbers every time. This lets engineers repeat an experiment from the same starting point. To fill billions of weights quickly, PyTorch, the software framework used in the development of most major AI models, divides the work that Philox does among many parallel workers on the GPU, called threads. (It does this through cuRAND, NVIDIA’s library for random number generation.) Each thread generates its own sequence of numbers from the seed and fills a particular set of positions. The number of threads then determines how those positions are shared out. On the NVIDIA chips examined here, a sufficiently large initialization uses the maximum of 2,048 threads for each processing unit, called a streaming multiprocessor (SM). A chip with more SMs therefore assigns the same job to more workers, changing where their numbers go. Figure 1 illustrates how this works on a simplified GPU with six SMs and eight threads per SM, giving 48 threads in total. Imagine the weights as a long row of empty boxes, wrapped into a grid to fit on the page. The first thread fills the first box, the second fills the second box, and so on through all 48 threads. The first thread’s next number then goes into box 49, its next into box 97, and so forth. The black outlines follow this one thread through the grid: the first thread fills every 48th position. The colors identify which processing unit supplies each set of values, while the brightness in the right-hand panel represents the value itself. Now keep the seed fixed, but use a GPU with five SMs instead of six. In our simplified example, that means 40 threads rather than 48. The first thread generates exactly the same sequence, but now puts its numbers in boxes 1, 41, 81, and so on, rather than boxes 1, 49, 97. Figure 2 follows these numbers as their positions change. Across the grid, only 6 percent of the values match the original arrangement. The seed is right, but the worker count is wrong. That is what makes the arrangement of model weights a clue to the chip used to create it. Reproducing the weights therefore requires two things to be right at once. The seed must generate the right numbers, and the thread count must put them in the right places. A correct seed with the wrong thread count mostly gives the right numbers in the wrong positions; a correct thread count with the wrong seed gives different numbers. Figure 3 shows why only the correct combination recreates the original arrangement. On real chips, the thread counts are much larger, but the principle is the same. In the NVIDIA configurations examined here, the Hopper H100 SXM, H200 and H800 have 132 SMs and use 270,336 threads; the Blackwell B200/B300 have 148 SMs and use 303,104 threads; and the Blackwell GB200/GB300 have 152 SMs and use 311,296 threads. Recovering the thread count therefore tells us which of these hardware groups matches the starting arrangement, although it cannot distinguish chips within a group. A Hopper match, for example, cannot tell an H800 from an H100 or H200. The question is whether enough of that arrangement survives training for us to recover it. Some weights, such as those reserved for words or symbols never encountered during training, can remain untouched and retain their starting values almost exactly. We can compare these preserved values directly with the starting values generated by a candidate seed and thread count. Figure 4 shows such a comparison: DeepSeek-V3’s preserved weights match the Hopper arrangement, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s match the Blackwell arrangement. Even weights that training has changed can retain a faint trace of their starting values. Each final weight is its starting value plus all the adjustments made during training. If those adjustments do not completely cancel or overwhelm the starting differences, some of those differences survive. For example, two weights that begin at 0.2 and 0.8 and each increase by about 0.1 will still be ordered the same way afterward. Real adjustments vary much more, so one weight tells us little. But across hundreds of thousands of weights, we can test whether higher starting values still tend to correspond to higher final values. Figure 5 shows this weak but measurable relationship. It is a finding in these weights, not a property guaranteed to survive every training run. These surviving traces let us work backward. Suppose, in an invented example using Figure 1’s layout, seed 7 makes the first thread produce 0.2, −0.5 and 0.8. With 48 threads, those values go into positions 1, 49 and 97; with 40 threads, they go into positions 1, 41 and 81. If the published weights preserve the first pattern, we can try candidate seeds and thread counts until we recreate it. In the actual investigation, we compare thousands of values in their corresponding positions. Untouched weights can match exactly; trained weights may show only the weaker resemblance described above. In either case, we look for the combination that best reproduces the surviving pattern. We then test that combination on weights we kept out of the search. Having chosen a seed and thread count using one set of weights, we use them to predict the starting values of a different set, without changing either setting to improve the fit. A match on these previously unused weights is stronger evidence than a match confined to the weights that helped us choose the combination. Figure 6 shows the comparisons: DeepSeek-V3 matches the initialization layout of Hopper H100 SXM, H200 or H800 chips; DeepSeek-V4-Flash matches Blackwell B200/B300; and Kimi K3 matches Blackwell GB200/GB300. In our investigations, we found patterns strongly suggestive of initialization on Blackwell chips in six models from four Chinese companies: DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro from DeepSeek, Kimi K3 and Kimi K3.1-Pro from Moonshot AI, MiniMax-M3 from MiniMax, and Ling-3.1-flash from Ant Group. V4-Flash and MiniMax-M3 match the 148-SM layout; the other four match the 152-SM layout. These are fingerprints of the starting weights, which support, but do not by themselves prove, the use of Blackwell chips for training AI models. Limits of our investigation Notably, the forensic method we used to identify the hardware on which these models were initialized only works for certain models. It needs published weights, so closed models cannot be checked. It also needs a recognizable, hardware-dependent pattern from the software that generated the starting weights. PyTorch on the GPUs examined here leaves such a pattern; Baidu’s PaddlePaddle framework, which was used to train Baidu’s ERNIE-5.5 model, does not. We were able to recover the seed for ERNIE-5.5 (2760), but could not identify which hardware was used to initialize it. Likewise, weights initialized on an ordinary processor rather than a GPU leave no GPU fingerprint; several of Alibaba’s Qwen3 models were initialized this way, and thus leave no trace of which GPUs were used to train them. We also found no fingerprint in Meituan’s LongCat-2.0, which the company says was trained on “AI ASIC superpods,” or in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, despite an exhaustive search. The method identifies the hardware that generated the starting weights, not every chip that later helped train the model. When a training run creates its weights on the same GPUs that will train it, the fingerprint points to both. But a lab could generate the weights on one system and move them to another, or continue training an existing model on new hardware. The weights alone cannot rule out those possibilities. A mixed cluster introduces the same limitation. If NVIDIA chips generated some weights and Huawei chips later helped train them, the NVIDIA pattern could survive without revealing Huawei’s participation. Different NVIDIA generations could leave different patterns in the parts they initialized, if those traces survived. In Kimi K3, at least 64 separately seeded processes each left the same 152-SM layout. A Blackwell-compatible pattern therefore supports its use at initialization, subject to the AMD alternative below; it does not establish that the entire training run used Blackwell. A Hopper pattern likewise does not rule out later training on Blackwell. The weights also cannot reveal who owned the chips or where they were located. Blackwell systems can be rented from data centers outside China. The evidence concerns access to the hardware; by itself, it does not establish that chips were smuggled into China or that an export-control violation occurred. Could a different chip produce one of these Blackwell-compatible patterns? Among the NVIDIA configurations tested here, the older chips cannot: software can use fewer of a chip’s processing units, but cannot give it more than it physically has. Under the standard PyTorch behavior examined here, they cannot produce the 148- or 152-SM layouts. The China-market Blackwell graphics cards use a different number of threads per SM and do not produce either total. AMD presents a different possibility. An MI300X normally uses 304 processing units, but it can be divided into two groups of 152 or configured to use only 148. Its random-number software can also generate the same underlying sequences as NVIDIA’s. Such configurations would be very unusual, but we confirmed on a physical MI300X that, limited to 152 or 148 of its units, it reproduces the layouts we associate with Blackwell, so the layout alone does not settle the question. To distinguish them, we looked for small numerical differences in the values themselves. AMD and NVIDIA perform one calculation in the number-generating process slightly differently. On a physical MI300X, DeepSeek-V4-Flash’s preserved weights point to NVIDIA: in the 377 values where the two vendors’ results differ, the published weight matches NVIDIA’s in 363 and AMD’s in none. The same test could not settle the other five models, but we consider the AMD explanation very unlikely for them. In its normal configuration, an MI300X produces neither layout; a lab would have had to configure an entire cluster to use the same number of processing units as a Blackwell chip. Other public evidence also points to Blackwell: U.S. officials and press reports have alleged that DeepSeek and Moonshot AI were using Blackwell chips, and Ant Group’s public code includes benchmark results generated on a GB300. Verifying our findings To reproduce the result that linked DeepSeek-V3 to Hopper and DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Blackwell, we ran unmodified PyTorch on a Hopper-class NVIDIA H100 and a Blackwell-class NVIDIA B300. We had identified DeepSeek’s seed number as 953049583, and found that it was used in the initialization of both DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Using that seed, the H100 reproduced the preserved starting values in DeepSeek-V3, but not V4-Flash; the B300 reproduced the preserved values in V4-Flash, but not V3. On the B300, unmodified PyTorch reproduced 461 of the 469 selected rows in DeepSeek-V4-Flash with correlations above 0.99, including 445 entire rows that matched bit for bit. Eight selected rows were partly changed by training. On the H100, it reproduced all 57,344 preserved values in DeepSeek-V3 bit for bit. Neither chip reproduced the other model’s preserved rows. Changing the seed by one reproduced no matching rows on either machine. On a rented GB200, unmodified PyTorch likewise reproduced all 13 of Kimi K3’s preserved rows using Moonshot’s seed, 20256586; changing the seed by one reproduced none. Our forensic method also gets the right answer when the answer is already known. There are 24 cases where a developer has publicly named the hardware behind a specific model; our forensic method agrees with every one. Meta’s Llama 3.1 models, trained on H100s, read as 132; eight of EleutherAI’s Pythia models, trained on A100s, read as 108. NVIDIA’s own Nemotron-3 Ultra, whose technical report names the GB200 for one phase of training, reads as 152, the same as Kimi K3. DeepSeek and Moonshot have reported H800 use for earlier models. Our Hopper readings are consistent with those disclosures, but would also be consistent with H100 SXM or H200 hardware; they do not independently verify H800 use. When we compare the published weights with the numbers generated by a candidate seed and chip layout, some resemblance is inevitable even if the candidate is wrong. How much resemblance counts as evidence depends on how many weights we compare: agreement across a handful of numbers could easily be accidental, while agreement across thousands is much harder to explain by chance. candidates.summary: Microsoft разрабатывает ИИ‑систему, которая сможет редактировать речь человека во время прямой трансляции. Компания подала патентную заявку, где описывается инструмент, способный распознавать определённые слова в аудиопотоке трансляции и заменять их другими. По утверждению Microsoft, ИИ предназначен
candidates.full: Microsoft разрабатывает ИИ‑систему, которая сможет редактировать речь человека во время прямой трансляции. Компания подала патентную заявку, где описывается инструмент, способный распознавать определённые слова в аудиопотоке трансляции и заменять их другими. По утверждению Microsoft, ИИ предназначен для удаления пауз и слов‑паразитов, кроме того, с его помощью можно цензурить ненормативную лексику. При этом в патентной заявке не предусмотрено обязательное уведомление зрителей о правках, что означает, что зрители могут смотреть трансляции, отредактированные ИИ, даже не подозревая об этом. Вторая патентная заявка описывает ипользование этой технологии в рамках перевода. Хотя YouTube и ряд других платформ уже поддерживают аудиоперевод с помощью ИИ, разработка Microsoft предполагает перевод прямых трансляций с синхронизацией движения губ говорящего. Весной Microsoft запатентовала ИИ‑инструмент, который будет проходить сложные участки в играх за пользователя. Согласно документу под названием State Management for Video Game Help Sessions, инструмент будет запускать отдельную облачную сессию, управление в которой можно будет передать стороннему участнику.

candidates.title: Δουβλίνο: Η πρώτη σύνοδος κορυφής της ΕΕ για την ΤΝ , καθυστερημένη και εν μέσω αναταραχής
candidates.summary: Οι ηγέτες της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης συνεδριάζουν σήμερα στο Δουβλίνο στην πρώτη τους σύνοδο κορυφής με θέμα την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη για να συζητήσουν πώς η ένωση μπορεί να προλάβει τις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες και την Κίνα στην τεχνολογία αυτή, καθώς και για να αντιμετωπίσουν ζητήματα χρηματοδότησης και άλλα πρ
candidates.full: Οι ηγέτες της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης συνεδριάζουν σήμερα στο Δουβλίνο στην πρώτη τους σύνοδο κορυφής με θέμα την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη για να συζητήσουν πώς η ένωση μπορεί να προλάβει τις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες και την Κίνα στην τεχνολογία αυτή, καθώς και για να αντιμετωπίσουν ζητήματα χρηματοδότησης και άλλα προβλήματα. Η συνάντηση συμπίπτει με την παγκόσμia αναταραχή από το μπλακ άουτ της Microsoft και πραγματοποιείται εν μέσω αυξανόμενων ανησυχιών για μια τεχνολογία η οποία υπόσχεται να μεταμορφώσει βιομηχανίες και κοινωνίες, όμως τους τελευταίους μήνες έχει προκαλέσει ανησυχίες έπειτα από μια σειρά επεισοδίων με ανεξέλεγκτους πράκτορες τεχνητής νοημοσύνης. Περαιτέρω αναταραχή προκλήθηκε αυτή την εβδομάδα με την παραίτηση του διευθύνοντα συμβούλου της Nvidia Τζένσεν Χουάνγκ, καθώς η βιομηχανία της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης έχασε έναν από τους μεγαλύτερους πρωταθλητές της. Οι ηγέτες στο Δουβλίνο θα εξετάσουν επίσης πώς μπορούν να ξεπεραστούν προβλήματα όπως η γραφειοκρατία και να θέσουν δικλίδες ασφαλείας. «Με δεδομένο τον ταχύ ρυθμό με τον οποίο αναπτύσσεται η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, πιστεύω ότι μια πρώτη συζήτηση αφιερωμένη σ’ αυτή, σε επίπεδο ηγετών, χρειάζεται τώρα σχετικά με τις ευκαιρίες που παρουσιάζονται από την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, καθώς και για τον μετασχηματισμό που επιφέρει στις οικονομίες και τις κοινωνίες μας», έγραψε την περασμένη εβδομάδα στην πρόσκλησή του προς τους ηγέτες ο πρόεδρος του Ευρωπαϊκού Συμβουλίου Αντόνιο Κόστα. Ο διευθύνων σύμβουλος της Mistal AI Αρτύρ Μενς και ο νομπελίστας πρωτοπόρος της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης Τζέφρι Χίντον θα ενημερώσουν τους ηγέτες της ΕΕ. Η Ευρώπη θα πρέπει να εντείνει τις προσπάθειές της, αν θέλει να είναι ένας πρωταγωνιστής στην τεχνητή νοημοσύνη. Μια πρωτοβουλία γνωστή ως Chips Act (Ευρωπαϊκός Νόμος για τα Μικροκυκλώματα), που εφαρμόσθηκε πριν από τρία χρόνια, φαίνεται ότι δεν επιτυγχάνει τον στόχο της να προσελκύσει κατασκευαστές και να διπλασιάσει το μερίδιο της ένωσης στην παγκόσμια αγορά μικροκυκλωμάτων στο 20% μέχρι το 2030. Ένα σχέδιο για την κατασκευή επτά γιγάντιων εργοστασίων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης (gigafactories AI, σύμφωνα με τον όρο που χρησιμοποιεί η Κομισιόν), τα οποία θα βάλουν κάτω από την ίδια στέγη προηγμένους επεξεργαστές, τεχνολογία υπολογιστικού νέφους (cloud), συνδεσιμότητα υψηλής ταχύτητας και κέντρα δεδομένων, δεν έχει ακόμα τεθεί πλήρως σε τροχιά υλοποίησης λόγω της διαμάχης μεταξύ χωρών της ΕΕ σχετικά με τις δαπάνες για την ανταγωνιστικότητα στον προϋπολογισμό της ένωσης για την περίοδο 2028-2034. Εκτός από την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, οι ηγέτες πρόκειται επίσης να συζητήσουν το ζήτημα της Ουκρανίας, το οποίο έχει προστεθεί ως το δεύτερο μείζον θέμα στην ημερήσια διάταξη, μία ημέρα αφού οι αμερικανοί απεσταλμένοι Στιβ Γουίτκοφ και Τζάρεντ Κούσνερ μετέβησαν στο Δουβλίνο για να συναντηθούν με τον ουκρανό πρόεδρο Βολοντίμιρ Ζελένσκι έπειτα από συνομιλίες τους με τον ρώσο πρόεδρο Βλαντίμιρ Πούτιν στη Μόσχα. Οι ηγέτες της ΕΕ αναμένεται ότι θα συζητήσουν για την ευρωπαϊκή συμμετοχή σε ειρηνευτικές διαπραγματεύσεις και για τις εγγυήσεις ασφαλείας που η ΕΕ θα μπορούσε εν δυνάμει να προσφέρει σε περίπτωση κατάπαυσης του πυρός, δήλωσε υψηλόβαθμος αξιωματούχος της ΕΕ. Πηγή: ΑΠΕ ΜΠΕ

candidates.summary: Nvidia Scandal Raises New Concerns About Scale of Chinese Spying The Jensen Huang saga is the latest example of what governments around the world say is a broad push by China to steal commercial and technological secrets and gather intelligence on foreign leaders and military plans. Security agenc
candidates.full: Nvidia Scandal Raises New Concerns About Scale of Chinese Spying The Jensen Huang saga is the latest example of what governments around the world say is a broad push by China to steal commercial and technological secrets and gather intelligence on foreign leaders and military plans. Security agencies around the world have raised the alarm, with the Federal Bureau of Investigation calling Chinese espionage "a grave threat to the economic well-being" of the US and Britain's MI5 saying it was running seven times as many China-related investigations in 2022 as four years earlier. China's spying push is intensifying, with Beijing using a range of tactics including hacking, human sources, and AI tools to obtain technological secrets and gather intelligence on foreign leaders and military plans, according to Western officials familiar with the matter. The revelation that Nvidia Corp.’s now ex-CEO had an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China has rocked the US artificial intelligence boom and thrust allegations that Beijing is seeking to infiltrate Western tech giants into public view. It fits into what foreign officials say is a globe-spanning project. Read More: Jensen Huang Exit Sets Up US-China Showdown Over AI Chip Curbs In Germany, prosecutors allege a married couple posing as interpreters and auto-industry employees cultivated professors in AI, computer science and aerospace, drawing some to China for paid “civilian” lectures delivered to state arms companies. New Zealand intelligence says a Chinese observatory with close government ties tried to install space-tracking equipment through a local company – gear that could also collect military intelligence. Taiwan says Chinese operatives trawl social media for indebted soldiers, offer loans, then press them for secrets and introductions to colleagues. Security agencies around the world have raised the alarm. The Federal Bureau of Investigation calls Chinese espionage “a grave threat to the economic well-being” of the US. Britain’s MI5 said it was running seven times as many China-related investigations in 2022 as four years earlier. Canadian intelligence calls China its “greatest counter-intelligence threat,” while Dutch intelligence says Chinese digital espionage against technology companies is happening on a “large scale.” Beijing has dismissed the Huang espionage allegations as a smear, accusing Washington of fabricating “Chinese spy narratives” to justify restrictions on technology exports. Despite those denials, the suspected spy at the center of the scandal that toppled Huang is now in China with the knowledge of the Chinese government. Read More: ‘I’m a Piece of Sh—’: Jensen Huang’s Last Hours as Nvidia CEO At stake is the balance of power between the world’s two largest economies. America has bet that its lead in AI and advanced semiconductors will underpin its continued economic strength and military superiority, while its ability to project force across the Pacific constrains Beijing’s ambitions over Taiwan. Espionage offers China a way to erode those advantages, accelerating its technological rise while gaining insight into Washington’s military plans and political decision-making. “There is a lack of appreciation for how professional the Chinese services have become,” said Holden Triplett, who ran the FBI’s office in Beijing and founded Trenchcoat Advisors, noting that parts of China’s intelligence service now rival the US Central Intelligence Agency and Russia’s Federal Security Service. “They’re hitting on human frailty and vulnerability and they’re spending all day thinking about how to do this,” he added. “Anyone can fall for it.” Read More: Jensen Huang Affair Fits China Spy Playbook: Businessweek Daily China’s spying push is intensifying in its backyard, where Beijing continues to expand its military footprint in the South China Sea. In the Philippines, suspected Chinese spies claimed to be using drones to carry fishing bait as they monitored warships around Subic Bay. Others posed as seafood buyers while flying drones near a naval base. In Manila, hired drivers cruised past the presidential palace, military camps and the US Embassy in cars fitted with fake cellphone towers capable of collecting data from nearby phones. Another vehicle, equipped with cameras and mapping technology, visited more than 120 locations, including bases used by American forces. The alleged operations reached deep inside the Philippine government. Authorities say suspected Chinese agents also recruited people inside the country’s defense establishment, obtaining names of naval personnel and schedules for troop rotations and resupply missions to disputed South China Sea outposts. The cases offered a rare glimpse into the scale and sophistication of Beijing’s espionage operations — which an investigator told Bloomberg were carried out by a spy network that numbered in the hundreds. China has dismissed the allegations as baseless. Read More: Philippines Probing Network of Hundreds of Alleged Chinese Spies “It is extremely widespread because that is the modus operandi of the Chinese,” Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro said in an interview. “It’s not only here — the United States. How many are being arrested? Within Australia, how many? In the UK, how many?” China’s Ministry of State Security is at the center of Beijing’s increasingly brazen espionage push. The country’s main civilian spy service combines the overseas remit of the CIA with a domestic remit like that of the FBI. Under Xi Jinping, reforms have tightened Beijing’s control over provincial and municipal intelligence bureaus, allowing the MSS to coordinate operations across the country and pursue more ambitious missions overseas. “It’s become more aggressive,” said Randy Phillips, a former CIA Beijing station chief. “If you look at the kinds of targets they’ve gone after in the last 10 years, they’ve become a much more emboldened organization.” The MSS is only one arm of what Britain’s parliamentary watchdog has called “the largest state intelligence apparatus in the world”: the People’s Liberation Army runs military, signals and cyber intelligence; the Ministry of Public Security operates at home and abroad; party bodies cultivate political, business and academic networks overseas. Xi has also handed intelligence agencies broader powers and obliged citizens and institutions to help them. The 2017 National Intelligence Law says every organization and citizen must “support, assist, and cooperate” with intelligence work. While the US and other countries spy on adversaries and allies, most argue that they don’t engage in industrial espionage the way that the MSS does and none have its scale. “The numbers in military and civilian intelligence and in the public security apparatus that feeds into intelligence are probably well into the millions,” Phillips said. Read More: How the US Got Inside China’s Elusive Spy Agency (Podcast) As the AI revolution has taken off, the technology that underpins it has become a crucial target for Chinese spy agencies, including obtaining it through hacking and human sources, which has made people working at the cutting edge in government, industry and academia potential targets, according to Western officials familiar with the matter. “The CCP considers itself as in pretty much an existential contest with the United States and other democracies. The hinge on which this contest will turn is scientific and technological power and central to that will be artificial intelligence,” said Peter Mattis, a former CIA counterintelligence analyst who is now president of the Jamestown Foundation. “Any C-suite in the AI industry is going to be an interesting target.” AI is also reshaping Chinese spycraft. The biggest gains come early in recruitment, helping services sift huge pools of potential targets and tailor approaches before a human officer steps in. In June, the FBI and Justice Department said suspected Chinese spies used fake consulting firms, lucrative job offers and AI-generated photographs to lure Americans with security clearances onto encrypted messaging apps. In October, US counterintelligence officials warned that Beijing was using AI tools including DeepSeek to profile American executives and government officials, identify their vulnerabilities and gain leverage over them. “With AI you just set up the algorithm to go after targets. You save a tremendous amount of manpower and searching – it’s a force multiplier,” said Dennis Wilder, the CIA’s former deputy assistant director for East Asia and the Pacific. Then, once targets are identified, Chinese agents can meet them online instead of undertaking risky travel overseas, Wilder said. “Human espionage doesn’t anymore have to be sneaking around back alleys.” AI is also bolstering China’s already formidable cyber capabilities. Microsoft said last month that the China-linked group Storm-0940 used agentic AI to automate attacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide. In September, Britain’s MI5 warned that the China General Technology Research Institute was funding research in AI and cybersecurity primarily to strengthen the Ministry of State Security’s espionage capabilities. More than 100 UK-linked academics had contributed to projects ultimately funded by the MSS, MI5 said, sometimes without knowing who was paying. “This isn’t the only operation against Nvidia. You should assume there are another 10 or more going on and of course it’s not the only operation going on against US tech,” said Triplett, the former FBI agent. “My guess is that they’ll be encouraged by how this worked out and they’ll do more and more of these operations.” — With assistance from Alex Wickham, Natalia Drozdiak, and Upmanyu Trivedi

candidates.title: Serbia terminates agreement with Jared Kushner's company for Belgrade luxury development
candidates.summary: Serbia terminates agreement with Jared Kushner's company for Belgrade luxury development Serbia has formally terminated its agreement with Atlantic Incubation Partners LLC, a company linked to Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of US President Donald Trump, over a planned luxury hotel, casino and residen
candidates.full: Serbia terminates agreement with Jared Kushner's company for Belgrade luxury development Serbia has formally terminated its agreement with Atlantic Incubation Partners LLC, a company linked to Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of US President Donald Trump, over a planned luxury hotel, casino and residential development at the former Yugoslav Army General Staff complex in Belgrade, according to Serbian weekly Vreme. The agreement, which concerned the redevelopment of the General Staff complex, was terminated with both parties waiving any potential claims against each other, Vreme reported, citing a source within the Serbian government. "The contract was terminated with a waiver of all potential mutual claims," the government source told Vreme. According to the publication, this should mean that Serbia no longer faces the prospect of arbitration proceedings or potential penalties for failing to fulfil its obligations under the agreement. Neither the Serbian government's General Secretariat nor Kushner's company responded to Vreme's requests for comment before publication. Agreement included a 99-year land concession The original contract was signed in May 2024 by then-Construction Minister Goran Vesic, following approval by the Serbian government. The agreement, which was initially not made public, concerned the construction of a hotel, casino and residential complex on the site of the General Staff buildings damaged during the 1999 NATO bombing. Serbian weekly Radar subsequently revealed that the agreement required Serbia to remove the site's protected heritage status, demolish the existing buildings at its own expense and provide the land to the investor free of charge for 99 years. According to Vreme, Serbia had two years, until May 2026, to fulfil those obligations. Failure to do so could have allowed the investor to seek compensation of up to €50 million. Controversy over removal of heritage protection The Serbian government removed the General Staff complex's status as a protected cultural property in November 2024. Before that decision, the directors of Serbia's national and Belgrade heritage protection institutes resigned, saying they had faced pressure after refusing to remove the site's protected status. Serbia's Prosecutor's Office for Organised Crime has alleged that the government based its decision on a falsified proposal. Goran Vasic, the acting director of the Republic Institute for the Protection of Cultural Monuments, admitted during questioning in May 2025 that he had falsified the document. Criminal proceedings and Kushner's withdrawal On December 15, the Prosecutor's Office for Organised Crime filed an indictment proposal against Culture Minister Nikola Selakovic, ministry secretary Slavica Jelaca, and two heritage protection officials, Goran Vasic and Aleksandar Ivanovic. Kushner's withdrawal from the project was announced on the same day. The formal termination of the agreement, as reported by Vreme, follows the controversy over the planned redevelopment of the General Staff complex and the legal proceedings concerning the removal of its heritage protection. Start your Independent Membership today. Join today Already a member? Log in SpaceX is launching Starship into orbit on Friday in its boldest test yet: a 22-hour flight that aims to recapture the entire rocket in a move meant to accelerate moon and Mars travel. If all goes well, the massive booster will return to its Texas pad six minutes after blasting off and the bullet-shaped spacecraft will steer there the next day. Both will be plucked from midair by mechanical arms secured to the launch tower. Everything was on track for Friday's planned late afternoon launch of the world's biggest and most powerful rocket, pending Federal Aviation Administration approval. If Elon Musk and his team succeed, it will be the first time every single piece of a rocket that is launched into orbit gets retrieved for the purpose of recycling. Musk sees this leading to the kind of fast and consistent launch rates necessary for building moon bases and sending people to Mars. “It’s hard to describe how I’m going to feel when we pull this off,” SpaceX’s Kiko Dontchev, vice president of launch, said at a NASA tech summit last week at Florida’s Kennedy Space Center. “It’s so incredibly exciting. It’s such a feat of engineering.” Once in orbit, Starship will deliver 26 of the company’s most advanced Starlink satellites. The plan is for Starship to complete 15 laps around the world at an altitude of around 170 miles (275 kilometers) before heading back to the launch site for Saturday’s grand finale. SpaceX has already made three booster grabs at the company’s sprawling Starbase near the U.S.-Mexico border. This will be the first attempt to capture the upgraded version that stretches 236 feet (72 meters) — the production model for moon and Mars travel. It will also be the first time the company attempts to catch the spacecraft, which spans 171 feet (52 meters). The spacecraft portion of the 14 previous Starships ended up in the ocean, either by design at flight’s end or by accident in a stream of flaming wreckage. During the first full-scale test flight in 2023, multiple engines failed to ignite and the tumbling rocket's self-destruct system was activated. The last test, in September, was the first to reach orbit, but SpaceX did not try to recover any of the rocket stages. SpaceX plans to start launching Starships from Florida within a few months and from Louisiana in a few years. Scaled-up infrastructure, combined with full rocket reusability, is “how you go from zero launches to 10 to 100 to 1,000 to 10,000 to 100,000,” Dontchev said. SpaceX’s smaller Falcon rockets will continue to fly from Cape Canaveral, carrying astronauts to the International Space Station for NASA and from California carrying Starlinks. Satellites also will keep hitching Falcon rides for now. Musk wants Starships to eventually replace Falcons. Falcon rockets “are still not fully reusable. We still throw that second stage away every single flight. Starship, we’re going to catch both the first stage and second stage,” Dontchev said. NASA is paying SpaceX billions of dollars to land Artemis astronauts on the moon with Starships. Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin is the other major player. NASA expects to decide a year before the Artemis IV lunar landing — the first by astronauts in more than half a century — whether to get the moonwalkers to the surface with Musk’s Starship or Bezos’ Blue Moon. During next summer’s Artemis III mission, astronauts will practice docking their capsule with a Blue Moon and then a Starship in orbit around Earth. That will set the stage for an Artemis moon touchdown as early as 2028. ___ The Associated Press’ health and science coverage receives financial support from the AP Fund for Journalism and private foundations. candidates.full: "Ми недовго раділи": "Флеш" пояснив, чому Starlink знову обмежив швидкість в Україні Київ • УНН Через нові обмеження Starlink ускладнився зв’язок із вертольотами та реактивними перехоплювачами "Шахедів". Раніше швидкість знижували до 161 км/год. Через проблеми у роботі Starlink знову виникли проблеми зі зв’язком із вертольотами, які переслідують "Шахеди", та з реактивними перехоплювачами, які збивають реактивні "Шахеди". Про це повідомив радник Президента України з питань розвитку технологічних напрямів оборони Сергій "Флеш" Бескрестнов, передає УНН. Деталі Швидкість роботи Starlink під час руху знову обмежили. Ми недовго раділи За словами Бескрестнова, ймовірно, американська сторона буде посилатися на умови військового тарифного плану для України, але кілька років ці умови нікого не турбували. До того ж будь-які умови можна змінювати й обговорювати, замість того, щоб залишати нашу країну без захисту неба Нагадаємо Президент України Володимир Зеленський за підсумками доповідей міністра оборони України Євгенія Хмари та Головнокомандувача ЗСУ Михайла Драпатого 12 листопада повідомив, що вже кілька днів фіксуються значні збої в роботі Starshield над територією України: вздовж усієї лінії фронту та на окупованих територіях діють системні обмеження швидкості Starshield на рівні 161 км/год. Start your Independent Membership today. Join today Already a member? Log in Shares of Nvidia, the chipmaker at the center of the global artificial intelligence boom, tumbled early Thursday with the tenure of CEO Jensen Huang threatened by revelations of an affair with a woman reported to be a suspected Chinese spy. The company's stock has been under pressure for weeks, both because of reporting about the affair and questions about a potential bubble in the AI sector. Shares slid 7% to $161.37 before the opening bell, 34% below the company's all-time high reached just over a month ago. The New York Times reported Wednesday that Huang had a second affair with an Nvidia executive who reports to him, and analysts said that may force the board to oust him. “What seemed impossible a week ago is now a reality as we cannot see Jensen running Nvidia as CEO at this point and the stock/company should be valued without him as CEO," wrote Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co. Nvidia is now valued at more than $4 trillion and has been a major driver in the technology sector. It is one of the reasons the tech heavy Nasdaq Composite index raced higher for most of this year and also part of the reason the index has slumped 7% in the past month. As the crisis unfolds at Nvidia, shares of rivals like AMD, Advanced Micro Devices, and Broadcom have moved sharply higher. CoreWeave, however slid nearly 9%. Nvidia owns a stake of approximately 13% in the a data center and cloud company.
